description: Fetch the spec twin of a SlickFast chart URL (api.slickfast.com/live/… or /e/…) — the exact JSON spec and data the image was rendered from. Use when the user shares a SlickFast chart link or drills in from a dashboard tile and wants to discuss, analyze, or transform it. Works with .svg/.png/.json chart URLs. Contacts api.slickfast.com only.

url.description: a SlickFast chart URL — live or ephemeral view (.svg/.png) or twin (.json)

name: read_chart
title: Read a shared SlickFast chart (get its data)
